blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Earth observation (EO) models are still built by hand. For each new task, experts design a training recipe and tune it against a benchmark. We show that this loop can be handed to an agent. Any verifiable task can be cast as a harness and a verifier, where the harness defines what the agent may use and the verifier defines what counts as success. Every EO task can be made verifiable, through labeled benchmarks, independent sensors, physical models or the repeated observation of the same place. Given only these two components, a general-purpose coding agent builds the EO model and improves it recursively on its own outputs. Settings long treated as separate research problems, from learning with a handful of labels to adapting across domains, become choices of harness and verifier. On four EO benchmarks spanning optical, SAR and multispectral time-series imagery, agent-built models surpass the state of the art and keep most of that accuracy from about 1% of the training labels. This establishes a new paradigm for EO, in which people design harnesses and verifiers and agents build the models, so EO models improve as agents do.
blocks.zh: 地球观测(EO)模型仍然由人工构建. 对于每一项新任务,专家都设计出一种培训方法,并参照基准加以调整。 我们显示这个循环可以交给代理商. 任何可核查的任务都可以作为牵引装置和验证装置,在这种装置中,验证装置界定了代理人可以使用什么,验证装置界定了什么是成功。 每个EO任务都可以通过标注的基准,独立的传感器,物理模型或同一地的反复观测来进行可核查. 仅考虑到这两个组成部分,通用编码剂就构建了EO模型,并根据自己的输出递归改进. 设置长期以来被视为单独的研究问题,从用少数标签学习到跨域适应,成为了使用和核实的选择。 在跨越光学、合成孔径雷达和多光谱时间序列图象的4个EO基准上,特制模型超过了最新水平,并且将大部分精确度保持在培训标签的1%左右。 这为EO建立了一个新的范式,在这种范式中,人们设计了用具和核查员以及代理商来构建模型,因此EO模型会像代理商一样得到改进.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Earth observation (EO) models are still built by hand. Each new sensor, region or task starts another round of engineering, in which experts choose a backbone, design a training recipe and tune it against a benchmark. Foundation models have raised the starting point of this cycle without removing it Cong et al. (2022) ; Reed et al. (2023) ; Guo et al. (2024) ; Xiong et al. (2024) ; Jakubik et al. (2025) ; Siméoni et al. (2026) , and on PANGAEA they do not consistently outperform a supervised UNet Marsocci et al. (2026) ; Xiao et al. (2025) . Across the many sensors, regions and label taxonomies of EO, expert engineering time decides how many tasks receive a strong model. The cost is highest where EO matters most. When a disaster strikes, a new satellite comes online, or a wildfire, flood or forest loss must be mapped in a new region, a strong model is needed within days, yet expert engineering takes weeks to months and many agencies and countries have no machine learning team at all.
blocks.zh: 地球观测(EO)模型仍然由人工构建. 每个新的传感器、区域或任务开始另一轮工程,其中专家选择骨干,设计培训配方并参照基准调整。 基础模型提高了这一周期的起点,但没有移除Cong等人(2022年);Reed等人(2023年);Guo等人(2024年);Xiong等人(2024年);Jakubik等人(2025年);Siméoni等人(2026年),在PANGAEA上,它们没有一贯地比受监督的UNet Marsocci等人(2026年);Xiao等人(2025年)。 在EO的许多传感器、区域和标签分类中,专家工程时间决定了有多少任务得到一个强大的模型。 在道德操守办公室最重要的地方,成本最高。 当灾害发生时,新卫星上线,或者野火、洪水或森林损失必须绘制出新区域的地图,几天内就需要一个强有力的模型,然而专家工程需要几周到几个月的时间,许多机构和国家根本没有机器学习团队。

(2025) , and coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex now write, run and debug training code for hours, earning medals in machine learning competitions Jiang et al. (2025) ; Chan et al. (2025) and improving training scripts against a validation metric Karpathy (2026) . EO agents have so far orchestrated fixed, human-built models and tools Singh et al. (2024b) ; Liu et al. (2024) ; Feng et al. (2026) , and a recent agentic research loop refines fully supervised baselines by one to three points Kang et al. (2026) . The EO task itself has not yet been handed to an agent.

Jiang等 (2025年); Chan等 (2025年),并改进了针对验证度量卡帕西 (2026年)的培训脚本. EO剂迄今已经设计了固定的、人造的模型和工具Singh等人(2024年b);Liu等人(2024年);Feng等人(2026年),最近一个剂学研究循环将充分监督的基线精炼了一至三分。 姜等 (2026) (中文(简体) ). 道德操守办公室的任务本身尚未交给代理人。

blocks.en: Our premise is that any verifiable task can be cast as a harness and a verifier. The harness defines what the agent may use, such as data, pretrained checkpoints, libraries and compute, and the verifier defines what counts as success by scoring the agent’s model ( Fig. 1 ). Every EO task can be made verifiable, and EO offers unusually many ways to do so. A decade of community benchmarks scores models on labeled held-out data, independent sensors and in-situ measurements check retrieved quantities, physical models check consistency with the observations, and repeated observation of the same place checks any prediction about its future. Building an EO model then becomes optimization against a verifier, and settings long treated as separate research problems become choices of these two components. Learning from a handful of labels restricts the labeled data in the harness, label-budget search asks for the smallest training set that passes a target score, and domain adaptation places the verifier on a target domain. We call this formulation RSI4EO.
blocks.zh: 我们的前提是,任何可核查的任务都可以成为一种手段和核查者。 检查者通过对检查者模式(图1)进行评分来界定成功与否。 每一个道德操守办公室的任务都可以加以核查,道德操守办公室为此提供了许多不同寻常的途径。 10年的社区基准对标有被搁置的数据、独立的传感器和现场测量检查检索的数量、物理模型检查与观测结果的一致性以及同一地点的反复观测对关于其未来的任何预测进行评分。 然后,建立一个EO模型成为对照核查器的优化,而设置长期作为单独的研究问题来处理,成为这两个组成部分的选择。 从少数标签中学习,限制被标注在被标注在被标注上的数据,标签-预算搜索要求通过目标分数的最小的训练集,域调整将被标注者放入目标域. 我们称之为RSI4EO。

blocks.en: Given a harness and a verifier, a general-purpose coding agent builds the model by itself. It writes training code, trains models, queries the verifier and decides what to try next, offline and without human input. The verifier is sealed and returns a score, and containerized execution keeps the held-out data and the network out of the agent’s reach Harbor Framework Team (2026) ; Merrill et al. (2026) ; Shi et al. (2026) . The agent improves the EO model recursively on its own outputs Yudkowsky (2013) ; Zelikman et al. (2024) and designs this recursion itself. With six labeled images, it runs eight generations of self-training, each taught by the best pipeline the verifier has seen, and ends by automating the loop with its own scripts. Because the two components specify the task completely, any agent can receive it.
blocks.zh: 由于具有牵引和验证器,通用编码剂本身就建立了模型. 它写出训练代码,火车模型,询问核查人,并决定下一步要试什么,离线和没有人类投入. 核查员被封存并返回一个分数,集装箱化执行使被扣留的数据和网络远离代理商的"港站框架"团队(2026);Merrill等 (2026);Shi等 (2026). 该剂在自身产出Yudkowsky(2013年);Zelikman等(2024年)的基础上不断改进了EO模型,并设计了这种再生本身. 它有6个被贴上标签的图像,运行了8代自训,每代都由核查员所看到的最好的管道传授,最后用自己的脚本将循环自动化. 由于这两个组件完全指定了任务,任何代理都可以接收.

blocks.en: Agents equipped this way surpass the state of the art on all four benchmarks with published results, land-cover mapping Xia et al. (2023) , building damage assessment from optical and SAR imagery Chen et al. (2025) , SAR ship instance segmentation Wei et al. (2020) and crop-type mapping from Sentinel-2 time series Sainte Fare Garnot and Landrieu (2021) , each within 12 hours on four GB200 GPUs, and the same agent builds a surface-material classifier from hyperspectral pixels Thoreau et al. (2024) . With labels for 0.1 to 1.4% of the training set they keep most of that accuracy, and on OpenEarthMap six labeled tiles yield 60.0 test mIoU. On OpenEarthMap, 300 tiles selected without labels suffice to surpass every published method trained on all labels, and two agents that build their models in very different ways both surpass the published state of the art.

blocks.en: These results point to a new paradigm for EO, in which people design harnesses and verifiers and agents build the models. A task’s harness and verifier stay fixed while agents improve, so EO models improve as agents do, without new human engineering. The time from a new need to a working model shrinks to the agent’s budget. After a disaster, responders can label a handful of image pairs from the affected area, pose them as a task and receive a damage model within a day. The few-label BRIGHT task, with one labeled image pair per disaster event, is a direct instance of this scenario. Wildfire, flood and deforestation mapping follow the same pattern, and a newly launched satellite can have a model within a day of its first labeled images. Above all, any agency or country that can define a task can obtain a model at the level of the published state of the art, whether or not it has a machine learning team. Research questions move upstream to which verifiers capture a task faithfully and what a harness must contain, and annotation moves from training sets to the held-out sets behind the verifier, which every benchmark already labels. Our contributions are threefold. • A Paradigm for Building EO Models. Any verifiable task becomes a harness and a verifier, which turns the many verification sources of EO into objectives that agents optimize directly and unifies learning settings as choices of these two components. • An Open EO Task Suite. We release the tasks of this paper in this form, covering optical, SAR, optical–SAR, multispectral time-series and hyperspectral imagery with pixel-level and instance-level outputs, runnable by any agent in offline Harbor containers. • Evidence across Tasks, Labels and Agents. Agent-built models surpass the state of the art on four benchmarks, keep 69 to 84% of that accuracy from 0.2 to 1.4% of the labels, and on OpenEarthMap beat every published full-label method from 11% of the labels.
blocks.zh: 这些结果指明了道德操守办公室的新模式,在这种模式中,人们设计了使用装置、核查员和代理人。 一个任务的操纵和验证器在代理商改进时保持固定,所以EO模型会像代理商那样改进,没有新的人类工程. 从新的需求到工作模式的时间缩短到代理的预算。 灾害发生后,救灾人员可以从灾区标出一对少数相片,将相片作为任务,并在一日内得到破坏模型. 少数标签的 BRIGHT 任务,每起灾害事件都有一个标签的图像对,是这种情景的一个直接实例. 野火,洪水和森林砍伐的测绘也遵循同样的模式,新发射的卫星可以在首个被标注的图像的一日之内有一个模型. 最重要的是,任何能够定义任务的机构或国家都可以在已公布的艺术状态层面获得模型,无论它是否有机器学习团队. 研究问题向上游发展,核查者忠实地抓住一项任务,必须包含什么,说明从培训到核查者背后的搁置,每个基准都标出。 我们的贡献有三个方面。 · 建立道德操守办公室模型的典范。 任何可核查的任务都变成一种牵引和验证手段,将EO的许多核查来源转化为目标,使代理人直接和统一学习环境,作为这两个组成部分的选择。 • 开放的道德操守办公室任务套件。 我们以这种形式发布本文的任务,涵盖光学、合成孔径雷达、光学-合成孔径雷达、多光谱时间序列和多光谱成像素级和实例级输出的多光谱成像,由离线港外集装箱中的任何物剂操作。 • 跨任务、标签和代理人的证据。 代理建造的模型在4个基准上超过了最新水平,将69%至84%的准确度从0.2%到1.4%的标签,在OpenEarthMap上从11%的标签上击败了每一个已公布的全标签方法.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: The idea of machines that design better machines goes back to Good (1965) and was formalized in the Gödel machine Schmidhuber (2007) . Language models now realize parts of this program. STOP uses a language model to improve the scaffold that calls it Zelikman et al. (2024) , Gödel Agent and the Darwin Gödel Machine rewrite their own agent code Yin et al. (2025) ; Zhang et al. (2026) , and FunSearch and AlphaEvolve evolve programs against automatic evaluators Romera-Paredes et al. (2024) ; Novikov et al. (2025) . Self-training lets a model improve on its own outputs, from Noisy Student in vision Xie et al. (2020) to STaR and ReST EM in language Zelikman et al. (2022) ; Singh et al. (2024a) and AlphaGo Zero in games Silver et al. (2017) , and in RSI4EO the agent arrives at such loops for the EO model without being told to. Progress in this line follows the availability of verifiers Sutton (2001) ; Wei (2025) , from trained verifiers for mathematics Cobbe et al. (2021) ; Lightman et al. (2024) to reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards Lambert et al. (2025) ; Guo et al. (2025) , and recent surveys and roadmaps chart the path toward recursive self-improvement in general AI systems Gao et al. (2026a) ; Chen et al. (2026) ; Duan et al. (2026) . RSI4EO carries this verifier-driven view into a scientific domain, where verifiers range from labeled benchmarks to the repeated observation of the same place and the artifact that improves recursively is the EO model.

blocks.en: AutoML has automated parts of model development for over a decade, through hyperparameter optimization Feurer et al. (2015) ; Li et al. (2018) ; Falkner et al. (2018) ; Akiba et al. (2019) , neural architecture search Zoph and Le (2017) ; Liu et al. (2019) ; Real et al. (2020) and self-configuring pipelines such as nnU-Net Isensee et al. (2021) , each searching a space that people define. LLM agents widen this space to arbitrary code. AIDE, The AI Scientist and autoresearch write and revise training code against validation metrics Jiang et al. (2025) ; Lu et al. (2026) ; Karpathy (2026) , and MLAgentBench, MLE-bench and RE-Bench measure such agents on engineering and research tasks Huang et al. (2024) ; Chan et al. (2025) ; Wijk et al. (2025) . Domain systems apply these loops to medical image segmentation Gao et al. (2026b) ; Liu et al. (2026) and solar-panel mapping Lekavicius et al. (2026) . RSI4EO differs in how a task reaches the agent, as a containerized task in the format of recent agent evaluation suites Merrill et al. (2026) ; Shi et al. (2026) . The harness and a sealed verifier specify it completely, so label budgets and domain shift become part of the task definition and validation data stay outside the agent’s reach, a design that reward-hacking studies of frontier agents support Von Arx et al. (2025) .

blocks.en: EO foundation models learn transferable representations from optical, multispectral and SAR archives Cong et al. (2022) ; Reed et al. (2023) ; Fuller et al. (2023) ; Jakubik et al. (2023) ; Guo et al. (2024) ; Xiong et al. (2024) ; Tseng et al. (2025) ; Astruc et al. (2025) ; Jakubik et al. (2025) , and general-purpose backbones such as DINOv3 now ship satellite-pretrained variants Oquab et al. (2024) ; Siméoni et al. (2026) , with GEO-Bench and PANGAEA evaluating them under fixed protocols Lacoste et al. (2023) ; Marsocci et al. (2026) . Label-scarce and cross-domain settings have each produced dedicated methods, including semi-supervised segmentation Yang et al. (2023) ; Yang et al. (2025) ; Lu et al. (2023) ; Zhou et al. (2026) and unsupervised domain adaptation Hoyer et al. (2022) ; Hoyer et al. (2023) , also on LoveDA Wang et al. (2021) ; Zhao et al. (2024) . In RSI4EO these models and methods become ingredients that the agent selects, combines and trains. LLM agents for EO have so far orchestrated fixed tools and pretrained models Singh et al. (2024b) ; Liu et al. (2024) ; Feng et al. (2026) ; Xu et al. (2026) ; Talemi et al. (2026) , and OpenEarth-Agent extends them to creating their own tools Zhao et al. (2026) . RingMoClaw is a multi-agent loop that retrains remote sensing models and improves fully supervised baselines on four tasks Kang et al. (2026) . RSI4EO hands an agent the whole EO task, including its label budget and domain shift, and extends agent-built models to label-scarce regimes.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: RSI4EO turns the construction of an EO model into a task that an agent solves. Section 3.1 defines a task by its harness and verifier, Sections 3.2 and 3.3 describe the two components as we instantiate them, Section 3.4 describes how the agent improves the model on its own outputs, and Section 3.5 shows how learning settings become choices of the two components.
blocks.zh: RSI4EO将EO模型的构建转化为一个代理解决的任务. 第3.1节用它的操纵和核查者界定了一项任务,第3.2和3.3节在我们即时描述这两个组成部分时,第3.4节描述了代理人如何根据自己的产出改进模型,第3.5节说明了学习环境如何成为两个组成部分的选择。

blocks.en: The formulation leaves every modeling decision to the agent. Architecture, losses, the use of unlabeled data, ensembling and inference all belong to the pipeline the agent writes, and the verifier is the only signal of success it receives. A task is fully specified by its two components, so any agent can receive it, and changing either component defines a new task.
blocks.zh: 配方将每个建模决定留给了代理商. 建筑,损失,无标签数据的使用,综艺和推论都属于代理所写的管道,而核查者是它收到的唯一的成功信号. 一个任务由它的两个组件完全指定,因此任何代理都可以接收它,而改变任何一个组件都定义了一个新的任务.

blocks.en: 3.2 Verifier
blocks.zh: 3.2 验证

blocks.en: The verifier is sealed. It runs in a separate container that holds the validation data, executes a submitted pipeline exactly as the final grader will, and returns the score through a tool call. The agent never receives validation images or labels. Because the verifier runs the whole pipeline, it scores what will be graded, including preprocessing, ensembling and test-time augmentation, and it exposes failures such as missing outputs before the final evaluation. The agent may query it as often as it likes.
blocks.zh: 验者被封. 它在一个单独的容器中运行,该容器持有验证数据,执行提交的管道与最终分级者完全一致,并通过一个工具调用返回分数. 代理从未收到验证图像或标签. 由于核查员运行整个管道,它得分的是将要分级的,包括预处理,综艺和测试时间的增强,并暴露出在最后评价前缺少产出等故障. 代理人可以随心所欲频繁地查询.

blocks.en: EO is rich in sources for such verifiers. Labeled benchmarks provide held-out sets, independent sensors and in-situ measurements check retrieved quantities, physical models check consistency with the observations, and repeated observation of the same place checks predictions against what is observed later. Each source yields a function that scores a pipeline without exposing its data to the agent. In this paper we build the verifier from labeled held-out sets, using the official validation split where it is not needed as the test set and otherwise a held-out portion of the training split selected by region or scene.
blocks.zh: 道德操守办公室为此类核查人提供了丰富的来源。 标签基准提供被搁置的装置、独立的传感器和现场测量检查检索的数量、物理模型检查与观测结果的一致性,以及重复观察同一地点对照以后观察到的情况检查预测。 每个源产生一个函数,对一个管道进行评分,而不将其数据暴露给该剂. 在本文中,我们用贴有标签的被搁置装置建造核查器,在不需要作为测试装置的地方使用正式验证分机,否则按区域或场景选择培训分机的被搁置部分。

blocks.en: 3.3 Harness
blocks.zh: 3.3 调和

blocks.en: The harness gives the agent what an EO researcher would start from. It contains the labeled training data and an unlabeled pool formed by the remaining training imagery, pretrained encoders without decoders or task heads (DINOv3 ViT-L/16 pretrained on satellite imagery, DINOv2 ViT-L/14, ResNet-18 to ResNet-101 and EfficientNet-B0 Siméoni et al. (2026) ; Oquab et al. (2024) ; He et al. (2016) ; Tan and Le (2019) ), the official source code of the DINO models, the Python deep-learning and geospatial stack together with QGIS, SAGA and GDAL, and a deliberately plain starter pipeline, an EfficientNet-B0 encoder with an FPN decoder Lin et al. (2017) . The agent has four GB200 GPUs and 12 hours, and no single training run may exceed 4 hours. The submitted pipeline must be a deep network that the agent trained, the given labels may not be edited, and the agent may annotate unlabeled data itself.

When time ends, the submission directory is copied out and graded once on the hidden test set under an inference budget of 4 hours. Nothing else the agent created survives, so every model, weight and script the final pipeline needs must be inside the submission.

blocks.en: 3.4 Recursive Improvement
blocks.zh: 3.4 递归性改进

blocks.en: Within a task, the agent improves the EO model recursively on its own outputs. We call each model the agent trains a generation. A generation f t f_{t} leaves outputs O t O_{t} behind, including its predictions and class probabilities on the unlabeled pool, its checkpoints, and its predictions on held-out folds of the training data. The next generation is trained from these outputs, f t + 1 = Train ⁡ ( ℋ , O ≤ t ) , f_{t+1}=\mathrm{Train}\big(\mathcal{H},\,O_{\leq t}\big), (2) and the verifier decides which generation is kept and serves as the source of the next one. Two loops therefore run together. In the outer loop, the agent proposes pipelines and the verifier scores them. In the inner loop, each kept model becomes material for its successor, so the model improves along a lineage.
blocks.zh: 在一项任务中,代理商根据自己的产出,对EO模式进行相继改进. 我们称每个模特都是一代人 一代 f t f_{t} 将输出 O t O_{t} 抛在后头, 包括它的预测和未贴标签的池子上的班级概率, 检查站, 以及它所预测的培训数据被搁置的折叠. 下一代从这些出品来训练出ft + 1 = train ⁡ (H, O  t),f_{t + 1}=\ mathrm{ train }\ big (\mathcal{H},\,O_{\leq t}\ }\ big),(2) 由核查者决定保留哪一代,并作为下一代的来源. 因此,两个循环是一起运行的。 在外环中,代理商提出管线并被核查者评分. 在内环中,每个被保存的模型会成为其后继者的物质,因此模型会沿着一行进行改进.

blocks.en: The agent designs this recursion itself. The task instruction permits methods such as pseudo-labeling on the unlabeled pool but prescribes none, and the agent chooses the mechanisms, their order and the depth of the lineage from the verifier’s feedback. Across our runs the mechanisms fall into three families. At the data level, a teacher labels the unlabeled pool with hard pseudo-labels or soft class probabilities and a student trains on them, as in Noisy Student Xie et al. (2020) and knowledge distillation Hinton et al. (2015) . At the parameter level, new models start from earlier checkpoints, average several checkpoints, or grow from a smaller trained network. At the prediction level, the agent trains models on its own predictions, such as calibrators fitted to out-of-fold predictions and networks that refine its masks. Each generation thus learns from the previous one, the pattern behind STaR Zelikman et al. (2022) and AlphaGo Zero Silver et al. (2017) , here applied to the EO model the agent builds.
blocks.zh: 代理设计了这种重现本身。 任务指令允许在未加标签的池上作假标签等方法,但没有规定,代理商从核查者的反馈中选择机制,其顺序和分界线的深度. 在整个过程中,各种机制都属于三个家庭。 在数据层面,一位教师用硬伪标签或软级概率标出无标签池并在上面贴上学生列车的标签,如Noisy Student Xie等 (2020)和知识分馏 Hinton等 (2015). 在参数一级,新的模式是从先前的检查站开始的,平均有几个检查站,或者从规模较小的训练有素的网络中发展。 在预测层面,物剂会根据自己的预测来训练模型,例如配有外向预测的计算器和完善口罩的网络. 因此,每一代人都从前一代学习了STAR Zelikman等人(2022年)和AlphaGo Zero Silver等人(2017年)背后的图案,此处适用于该剂所构建的EO模型.

blocks.en: 3.5 Learning Settings as Choices of Harness and Verifier
blocks.zh: 3.5 学习设置作为优势和验证的选择

blocks.en: Table 1: The five benchmarks. Training data form the harness, the verifier holds a validation split, and the test split stays hidden until the final evaluation. The few-label task keeps a few labeled samples per natural stratum, with their share of the training labels in parentheses, and moves the other training samples to the unlabeled pool. PASTIS counts the background as a class.
blocks.zh: 表1:五项基准。 训练数据组成了被拉带,核查者持有验证分解,测试分解会一直被隐藏到最后评价. 少数标签任务每个自然地层保留了几个有标签的样本,其培训标签的份额被括号中,并将其他培训样本移动到无标签的池中去. PASTIS将背景算作一个类.

blocks.en: Settings that EO research has treated as separate problems become choices of the two components. Full supervision gives the harness all training labels. Learning from few labels keeps one to five labeled samples per natural stratum of the data, such as a continent, a disaster event, a scene or a class, chosen so that together they cover every class, and moves the remaining training imagery to the unlabeled pool ( Table 1 ). A label-budget search fixes a label-free selection rule, ranks the training images with it, and asks for the smallest prefix whose labels let the agent reach a target score. Domain adaptation places the labeled data on a source domain and the verifier on the target domain. In every case the agent, the verifier interface and the final evaluation stay the same.
blocks.zh: EO研究作为单独问题处理的设置成为两个组成部分的选择. 全面监督给所有训练标签 从很少的标签中学习,每个自然数据层保留一至五个标签样本,如大陆、灾害事件、场景或班级,选择这些样本后,它们一起覆盖每个班级,并将剩余的训练图像移动到无标签的池中(表1)。 一个标签-预算搜索会修正一个没有标签的选择规则,用它来排序训练图像,并要求最小的前缀,其标签让代理商达到目标分数. 域名适应将被标注的数据放入源域上,将验证者放入目标域上. 在每一种情况下,代理人、核查人界面和最后评价保持不变。

blocks.en: This view also changes where annotation goes. Labels are needed for the verifier and for the final evaluation, which every benchmark already provides, while the training set can shrink to a handful of samples. Validation labels reach the agent only through the scores the verifier returns.
blocks.zh: 这种观点也改变了注释的内容。 核查员和最后评价需要标签,每个基准都已经提供了标签,而培训集可以缩小到少数样本。 验证标签仅通过验证员返回的分数到达代理.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: The experiments ask three questions that follow from the introduction. The first is whether one agent and one interface suffice across sensors, output types and label regimes. The second is how good the resulting models are, both against the plain pipeline that ships with the harness and against published methods. The third is how the amount of labeled data in the harness and the choice of agent change the outcome. Section 5 then examines the runs themselves to explain where the accuracy comes from.
blocks.zh: 实验提出了引言之后的三个问题. 首先是一种剂和一种接口是否足以跨越传感器、输出类型和标签制度。 第二是所产生的模型的优点如何,既与有绳索的船只的平地管道相抗衡,也与公布的方法相抗衡。 第三是带子中的被标注数据数量和剂的选择如何改变结果. 然后,第5节审查运行情况,说明准确性来自何处。

The same agent, through the same interface, builds a strong model for RGB, SAR, optical and SAR pairs, multispectral time series and hyperspectral pixels, and for semantic segmentation, instance segmentation and pixel classification. In all seven comparisons with the starter, the agent-built model is well above it. The gain is 5.6 to 16.7 points with full labels and 14.6 to 36.1 points with few labels. Each model is a system that the agent designed, trained and assembled from its own networks within 12 hours. On HRSID the agent reaches its score with 15% fewer training images than the published methods and without a pretrained detector. A run of this kind costs roughly 100 to 170 US dollars of model usage and at most 48 GPU hours ( Section A.2 ).

With 300 tiles, 11% of the training set, one agent already surpasses all 11 published methods of Table 2 , all of which train on the full label set. blocks.en: The two agents reach similar accuracy by different routes. GPT-6-Astra works in many small steps and runs experiments in parallel, and with six tiles it queries the verifier 341 times. Claude Opus proceeds in fewer and larger steps and queries the verifier 43 times in the same setting. GPT-6-Astra leads in three of the four settings and Claude Opus at 300 tiles, and from 600 tiles upward they differ by less than one point. With six tiles the deeper self-training lineage of GPT-6-Astra leads, and with 300 tiles the full fine-tuning of both DINO encoders by Claude Opus leads. The formulation thus does not depend on one agent or one working style.

blocks.en: 5 Analysis
blocks.zh: 5 分析

blocks.en: The trajectories record every command, message and verifier query of a run. We use them to examine three points. The first is that the agent improves the model recursively on its own outputs without being told to. The second is that the agent takes over the engineering that experts otherwise carry out. The third is how far a model selected against a sealed verifier generalizes to data the agent never accesses. Further observations on how the agents use the verifier and spend their budget, and on what follows for the design of harnesses and verifiers, are reported in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 轨迹记录了运行的每一个命令,消息和验证查询. 我们用它们来检查三点。 第一,代理人在不被告知的情况下,会按自己的产出来递增模型。 二是代理人接管专家以其他方式执行的工程. 第三是对照密封的核查者选择的模型对代理人从未访问过的数据进行归纳的程度。 附录A报告了关于代理人如何使用核查员和如何使用其预算的进一步意见,以及设计取材机和核查员的随后意见。

The agent compares encoders on the verifier, pseudo-labels the unlabeled pool with its best model, and runs eight generations in which the best verified pipeline teaches a student that continues from the previous generation. In the later generations, controller scripts written by the agent select the teacher from the verifier log and start the next generation. The final three-network ensemble scores 60.0 mIoU on the hidden test set.

blocks.en: 5.1 Recursion in Practice
blocks.zh: 5.1 实践中的追溯

blocks.en: The six-label OpenEarthMap run shows the recursion most clearly ( Fig. 2 ). The agent first uses the verifier to choose an encoder, then labels all 4,194 unlabeled tiles with its best model and trains a student on the six labeled tiles and this pseudo-labeled pool. From there it runs eight generations. In each, the teacher is the best pipeline the verifier has seen so far, and the student continues from the previous generation’s checkpoint. The verifier score rises in every generation, from 56.7 to 61.9 mIoU, which is 9.0 points above the best model the agent trained on the six tiles alone. The agent then automates this loop. It writes scripts that read the verifier log, promote the best pipeline to the next teacher and start a new generation when the teacher has improved. The last generation was launched, trained and verified by these scripts alone. The recursion thus extends from the model to the procedure that improves it.
blocks.zh: 六分标签开阔地 地图运行最清楚地显示复发(图2). 代理商首先使用校验器选择编码器,再用其最好的模型给所有4,194个无标签的瓷砖贴上标签,并在六块有标签的瓷砖和这个有伪标签的花池上训练一名学生. 从那里流出八代. 在每一个项目中,教师是核查人员迄今所看到的最好的管道,学生从上一代的检查站继续学习。 核查员的分数每代都从56.7到61.9 mIoU,比仅在六块瓷砖上训练的特工的最佳模型多出9.0分. 代理商将这个循环自动化. 它会写出读取校验日志的脚本,将最好的管道推广到下任老师,并在老师改进后开始新一代. 后一代仅由这些剧本发起,训练和核实. 因此,这种重复从模式延伸到改进模式的程序。

blocks.en: The few-label runs on OpenEarthMap, BRIGHT and HRSID all arrive at teacher–student loops over the unlabeled pool, with eight generations on OpenEarthMap, ten on BRIGHT and five on HRSID, and Claude Opus runs four on OpenEarthMap. No instruction asks for them. The loops also differ in what passes from one generation to the next. On BRIGHT the teacher is a three-stage pipeline of a building detector, a damage network and a building-level classifier, and on HRSID it is a detector followed by a network that predicts each mask from a crop around the detected box.

The verifier shows the agent when another generation of the same kind stops paying, and the agent responds with such a change.

blocks.en: 5.2 What the Agent Contributes
blocks.zh: 5.2 国家 特工的贡献

blocks.en: Figure 3 shows how the verifier score of each run approaches its final value. Across the 10 runs of GPT-6-Astra with recorded trajectories, half of the final gain is reached after a median of 0.85 hours and 90% after 3.5 hours. The steps taken in this early phase are of a few recurring kinds.
blocks.zh: 图3显示每个运行的核查者得分如何接近其最终值。 在GPT-6-Astra的有记录的轨迹的10个运行中,最后收益的一半在中位数0.85小时后达到,90%在3.5小时后达到. 在这一早期阶段采取的步骤有几起反复出现。

blocks.en: • Choosing Pretrained Encoders with the Verifier. Replacing the starter encoder by a frozen foundation encoder is the largest single step in several runs, with 11.1 points on six-label OpenEarthMap and 7.3 on few-label BRIGHT, each within the first 15 minutes. The verifier also corrects plausible priors. With six OpenEarthMap tiles, DINOv2 scores 52.2 mIoU and the satellite-pretrained DINOv3 47.2, and on PASTIS the agent finds that pixel-wise temporal models contribute more than DINO features. • Matching Model Capacity to the Labels. Across the few-label runs, early checkpoints often beat later ones, and the agent infers from the verifier that fitting a handful of labels more closely reduces accuracy. • Debugging. The largest step of the full-label HRSID run, 5.2 AP, comes largely from correcting a half-pixel offset in mask refinement, which the agent found by inspecting its outputs. Earlier in the same run it had traced misplaced masks to a loss of box-coordinate precision under mixed precision. • Task-Specific Structure. On BRIGHT with few labels, the agent separates the confidence that a pixel is a building from the confidence in its damage grade when it trains on pseudo-labels, which adds 2.2 points in a controlled comparison. It later assigns building footprints to a separate optical detector, which adds a further 1.1 points.

blocks.en: These are the choices of backbone and training recipe that experts otherwise make by hand ( Section 1 ). Here the agent makes them from the verifier’s feedback, and it makes most of them within the first hours of a run. A model close to the final one therefore exists within the first hours of a run ( Section A.2 ).
blocks.zh: 这些是专家用手做的骨干和培训方法的选择(第1节)。 代理商通过核查员的反馈来制作, 因此,在运行的头几个小时内就存在接近最后一种模式(A.2.节)。

blocks.en: 5.3 Generalization beyond the Verifier
blocks.zh: 5.3 超出验证范围的概括

blocks.en: The agent selects among up to several hundred candidates with the verifier, and on OpenEarthMap, PASTIS, HRSID and BRIGHT the score it optimizes carries over to the hidden test. Table 5 in the appendix lists the verifier and test scores of every run. The hidden-test score lies within about 2 points of the verifier score in all seven OpenEarthMap runs listed there and within 0.2 points on PASTIS. On HRSID the test score is higher by about 3.5 AP, because the official test images come from the same scenes as the training images whereas the verifier holds separate scenes.
blocks.zh: 代理从多达几百名候选人中挑选出核查员,在OpenEarthMap、PASTIS、HRSID和BRIGHT上,其最佳得分随同隐藏测试。 附录中表5列出了每次运行的核查和测试分数. 隐藏测试分数位于该地列出的所有7个"开地地图"(OpenEarthMap)中核查分数的约2分以内,PASTIS上则在0.2分以内. 在HRSID上,测试分数高了约3.5 AP,因为官方测试图像来自与训练图像相同的场景,而核查者则持有单独的场景.

blocks.en: On OpenEarthMap the run with 341 queries has a gap of 1.9 points, and the run with 8 queries has a gap of 1.3. In both, and in every other OpenEarthMap run, the gap is concentrated in the same two classes, bareland and water. On BRIGHT, three quarters of the 3.5 to 4.0 point difference come from the destroyed class, which covers 1.38% of the validation pixels and 0.93% of the test pixels, and its test IoU of 61.5 is below the 65.4 that the first, untuned submission of the run obtained on the verifier. On these benchmarks the gaps mainly reflect differences between the validation and test splits. This agrees with studies of benchmark reuse, which find that repeated model selection on a held-out set causes little overfitting Recht et al. (2019) ; Roelofs et al. (2019) .
blocks.zh: 在开放地上 映射出341个查询的跑道有1.9分的差距,而8个查询的跑道有1.3分的差距. 在这两种情况下,以及在所有其他的OpenEarthMap跑道中,差距集中在同样两个等级,即赤地和水. 在BRIGHT上,3.5到4.0分差的四分之三来自被破坏的分级,该分级覆盖了1.38%的验证像素和0.93%的测试像素,其测试的61.5IoU低于第一个在验证器上获得的分级的65.4分,未调节的提交. 在这些基准上,差距主要反映了验证和测试划分之间的差异。 这与关于基准再利用的研究是一致的,研究发现,在被搁置的套装上反复选择模型不会造成Recht等人(2019年)的过度适应;Roelofs等人(2019年)。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We have shown that any verifiable EO task can be cast as a harness and a verifier, and that a general-purpose coding agent given these two components builds EO models that surpass the state of the art on four benchmarks and keep most of that accuracy from about 1% of the training labels. The formulation separates what people specify from what agents build. The harness and the verifier of a task stay fixed while the agents that solve it improve, so every advance in agent capability turns into better EO models without new human engineering. The time from a new disaster, satellite or region to a working model then becomes the agent’s budget, and any agency that can define a task can obtain a state-of-the-art model. As AI capability continues to rise, we see this as the paradigm in which EO models will be built, with human effort invested in the harnesses and verifiers that define the tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们已经证明,任何可核查的EO任务都可以被设定为一种牵引和验证器,而赋予这两个组件的通用编码剂构建了EO模型,这些模型在四个基准上超越了最先进的水平,并且将大部分精确度保留在大约1%的训练标签上. 其配方将人们所指明的与物剂所构建的区分开来. 任务的牵引和验证器在解决它时会固定下来,而解决它的特效则会改进,所以每个代理能力的进步都会变成更好的EO模型,而没有新的人类工程. 从新的灾难、卫星或区域到工作模式的时间就成为代理人的预算,任何能够确定任务的机构都可以获得最先进的模式。 随着人工智能能力的不断提高,我们将此视为将构建道德操守办公室模型的范例,人为确定任务的机床和核查器投入了精力。

blocks.en: Appendix A Exploratory Analysis of the Trajectories
blocks.zh: 附录A 轨迹探索分析

blocks.en: This appendix adds detail on how the agents use the verifier and spend their budget, and on what follows for the design of harnesses and verifiers.
blocks.zh: 本附录详细介绍了代理人如何使用核查员并使用其预算,以及设计用具和核查员的随后情况。

blocks.en: A.1 How Agents Use the Verifier
blocks.zh: A.1 代理人 使用验证符

blocks.en: Table 5: How each run with an available trajectory used the verifier. Runs are grouped by whether the agent set aside part of the training labels for local validation. Queries counts the pipelines submitted to the verifier, and the gap is the best verifier score minus the hidden-test score, in points. Astra and Opus stand for GPT-6-Astra and Claude Opus 5.5. The gap follows the benchmark more closely than the number of queries.
blocks.zh: 表5:每个有轨迹的运行如何使用核查器。 运行按代理是否为本地验证预留了部分培训标签进行分组. 查询数为提交核查人的管道,缺口为最佳核查分数减去隐藏测试分数后,以分数计. Astra和Opus代表GPT-6-Astra和克洛德·奥普斯5.5. 差距比查询次数更接近基准。

blocks.en: The number of verifier queries per run ranges from 8 to 341 ( Table 5 ). This spread reflects whether the agent builds a validation signal of its own. Where it holds out part of the training labels, it screens candidates locally and sends a median of 13 pipelines to the verifier for confirmation. Where it does not, the verifier becomes the only validation signal and the median rises to 115. The agent then submits every checkpoint and writes controller scripts that queue pipelines, read the scores and promote the best one automatically. Claude Opus behaves in the same way. It issues 8 to 13 queries when it has a holdout and 43 with six tiles, where it notes that it will rely on the verifier because leave-one-tile-out validation is too noisy.
blocks.zh: 核查员每次查询的次数从8次到341次不等(表5)。 这种分布反映了代理是否构建了自己的验证信号. 如果它持有部分培训标签,就在当地筛选候选人,并将13个管道的中位数送交核查员确认。 如果没有,则验证器成为唯一的验证信号,中位数上升到115. 然后代理提交每个检查点,并写出控制器脚本来排队管线,读取分数并自动推广最佳. 克洛德·奥普斯的行为也一样. 它发出8至13个询问,当它有阻断,43个则有6个瓦片,它指出它将依赖核查员,因为留一瓦片的验证太吵了。

blocks.en: A.2 Budget, Stopping and Cost
blocks.zh: A.2 预算、停止和费用

blocks.en: The full-label BRIGHT run gains 2.5 points of verifier mIoU in its first 1.8 hours. Every run with a recorded trajectory was ended by the agent before the time limit, at a median of 10.6 hours, and the two Toulouse runs ended after 1.3 and 2.8 hours. The 12-hour budget is thus an upper bound, and a model close to the final one is available within the first few hours, the time scale that rapid response requires.
blocks.zh: 全标签的BRIGHT在头1.8小时里获得了2.5分的验证器mIoU. 每一次有记录出轨的跑道被代理在时限前以10.6小时的中位数结束,而两个图卢兹跑道在1.3和2.8小时后结束. 因此,12小时的预算是一个上限,在最初几小时内就有一个接近最后预算的模型,这是快速反应所需的时间尺度。

blocks.en: The model-usage cost of 100 to 170 US dollars per run of GPT-6-Astra behind Table 2 is estimated from the logged token counts.
blocks.zh: 表2后面的每批GPT-6-Astra的模型使用费为100至170美元,根据记录的代号计算估计。

blocks.en: A.3 Lessons for Harness and Verifier Design
blocks.zh: A.3 利用和验证设计的经验教训

blocks.en: The observations of this appendix suggest two rules. The harness should contain what local validation needs, such as the grouping of samples into scenes, events or polygons. The verifier should be representative of the test distribution and can report the uncertainty of its scores.
blocks.zh: 本附录的意见提出了两项规则。 牵引装置应包含当地验证需要的内容,例如将样品组合成场景,事件或多边形. 核查者应代表测试分布情况,并可报告其分数的不确定性。
